### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **0** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 2a4254a608cc290214633883b8858969db791c21` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c1770a3875778c2a07f91dcff1941586215bb884`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #20395 (body; comments 5865123040, 5870067887, 5923248286, 5923384068, 5924107460 as stored after its one edit); PR #21045 (body read twice — 13228 bytes at creation, 15213 bytes after the seat's append; file list, 7 files; the API diff, byte-identical to `git diff 2f2fa11d7..c1770a387` modulo index lines); the head's check-runs (two reads); objectstack at the merge-base `2f2fa11d7`, at `origin/main` `d67b94280` and at the head; objectui at the pinned sha `db11afd4967cd9d39381c5e21dc2deec9d706204` (`.objectui-sha` reads the same at the head and at `origin/main`); ruling 5864668610 and PR objectui#10973 (merged `deca847a8`). `main`'s advance since the base touches none of the seven files, so the diff against current `main` is the same 7 files, +33/-15.

### ① Derived judgments

**(a) Every sentence about the hook, read at `db11afd49`.** `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/react-page.tsx` imports `useAdapter, useDataInvalidation` from `@object-ui/react` (:47); the scope memo (:186-206) spreads `buildComponentScope(adapter)` and adds `useAdapter`, `useDataInvalidation`, `data`, `variables`, `page`, with dependencies `[schema, adapter]` only, so the scope identity, and with it the page's own state, is unchanged by the new member. `packages/react/src/data-invalidation.ts:106` declares `export function useDataInvalidation(objectName?: string, recordId?: string): number` — a `useState(0)` counter incremented once per bus change for which `dataChangeMatches` holds (`'*'`, or the same `objectName`; a record-scoped change also stales a reader that passed no `recordId`); with no `objectName` it subscribes to nothing and stays 0. Its docblock (:96-104) prescribes exactly the use taught here: the nonce in the fetch effect's dependency array, "the refetch happens in place, no remount". The bus is fed by `useMutationInvalidationBridge(dataSource)`, mounted once at `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:449`; the ListView renderer reads the same hook at `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/data-list.tsx:137`. `PageView` at the pin keys on identity and no longer remounts after a page action (its header :34-37; `no-refresh-key-remount.ratchet.test.ts` holds it), and objectui's own pin `react-page-invalidation.test.tsx` asserts "one bus event on the page object re-runs the page read once, in place, with no remount" plus the lit control. Against that reading: the scope-table row in `react-pages.mdx` (returns a number that moves when a write to that object is reported on the bus; name it in the dependencies of the effect that reads through `useAdapter`) — true; the Live data paragraph (reported on the bus, the same bus the ListView block refreshes from, the nonce moves, the effect runs again in place, the page is not remounted so its state survives) — true; the `pages.md` bullet (the data-invalidation bus nonce, a number; name it in the deps of the effect that reads through `useAdapter`, so a page action elsewhere that writes `obj` re-runs that read in place, with no remount) — true; the generator's two strings (the scope line gains `useDataInvalidation`; the Live-data note: a number that moves when a write to `obj` is reported, name it in the deps of the effect that reads through `useAdapter`, re-runs in place with no remount) — true. No sentence claims more than the pin delivers.

**(b) The Live data example.** `const changed = useDataInvalidation('showcase_invoice')` and `}, [adapter, changed]);` — the nonce is in the dependency array; the read is on `showcase_invoice`, the same object the nonce names. The one-paragraph why is the mechanism in (a) and nothing else. The `[Live data](#live-data)` link targets the `## Live data` heading at :165; `Check Documentation Links` is success. The page's other sample ("A complete page", :422-494) has no `useAdapter` effect, so no untaught site remains on the page.

**(c) `pages.md`'s paid line.** Read at the base: the deleted text is one sentence over four blockquote lines — the contract covers the curated core set; runtime-injected blocks outside it (`ObjectMetric`, `ObjectKanban`, …) read their props from the block registry at render time; except the `record:*` family, rejected on this surface. Each teaching has a home in the bullet directly above it at the head (:176-190): "The scope is built at runtime from the public block registry (every non-container public block gets a PascalCase wrapper), so blocks like `ObjectMetric` / `ObjectKanban` exist even though the written contract below documents only the curated core set"; "Exception — the `record:*` family is NOT usable here … `os validate` rejects them here (`react-block-needs-record-context`)". The one phrase with no surviving spelling, "read their props from the block registry at render time", names the runtime mechanism, not an author action; its author-facing consequence (the written contract covers only the core set; the `data` props come from the spec schemas — the blockquote sentence that stays) survives. Not a lost rule. Counts, `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)` (the convention at `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs:184`): 453 → 453 lines, 22724 → 22701 bytes, 5681 → 5676 tokens; ceiling row `['skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md', 5692]` at :536, untouched (the diff touches nothing under `scripts/`). `git diff -U0` shows exactly two hunks, `-171,0 +172,3` and `-203,4 +206,1`: no untouched line re-wrapped. The ratchet and its `--self-test` run in `Type Check · source gates` (success). The dev's own numbers match. (The PR body says "two sentences", the report "a restated blockquote sentence"; it is one sentence — immaterial.)

**(d) The generator.** The diff to `packages/spec/scripts/build-react-blocks-contract.ts` is two string literals (the `note` at :139, the scope line at :172). The script's only emit target is `OUT_MD = skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md` (:29, :174); `react-blocks.md` moved by exactly those two lines (:10 and :115), 115 → 115 lines, 3340 → 3409 tokens — the +69 is the note sentence. `check:react-blocks` (`tsx scripts/build-react-blocks-contract.ts --check`) runs in `Type Check · source gates`, success: the committed file is the script's output. `skills/objectstack-ui/references/_index.md` is byte-identical between base and head; both it (`skills/*/references/_index.md`) and `react-blocks.md` are `merge=os-regen` rows (`.gitattributes:165-166`), neither hand-edited.

**(e) The two showcase pages.** A `.page.ts` is `definePage({ kind: 'react', source: \`…\` })` — the react source is a template-literal string; `useDataInvalidation` resolves at render from the injected closure scope, so no import exists to add and `tsc` never sees the identifier. `crm-workbench.page.ts`: one nonce, `projectChanged = useDataInvalidation('showcase_project')`; the KPI effect reads `showcase_project` and its dependencies are `[refreshStats, reloadKey, projectChanged]` — right. `renewals-pipeline.page.ts`: two nonces, `showcase_project` and `showcase_invoice`, the two objects the rollup reads (the hook takes one object; a reader on `'*'` matches only wildcard changes, so two readers is the correct spelling); dependencies `[adapter, sel, reload, projectChanged, invoiceChanged]` — right; the first `React.useEffect(` in the source (:86) is still the rollup, so the harness's anchor in (f) still lifts it. `objectstack validate` rides `Dogfood Verify CLI` (success); the showcase `tsc --noEmit` rides `Type Check · workspace` and its `vitest run` rides `Test Core`, both still in progress at my second read (recorded in ③).

The dev's double-run note, judged: for CRM Workbench it is a correct upper bound — a save in the page's own `ObjectForm` on `showcase_project` bumps `reloadKey` in `afterSave` and the same write reaches the bus through the bridge and moves `projectChanged`; whether that is two effect runs or one depends on whether React batches the two state updates into one commit, and the result is the same rows either way. For Renewals Pipeline it is not a correct reading: the page's own form is the drawer on `showcase_account` (:177-181), whose write is reported on `showcase_account` — matched by neither nonce — so only `reload` moves and the rollup runs once. The PR body's rationale for keeping the counters ("they also key the ListView and ObjectForm remounts those pages do") holds for CRM Workbench (`key={reloadKey}` on both blocks) and not for Renewals, where `reload` keys nothing and is solely the rollup's dependency (:64, :107, :180); keeping it there is still right, because an account save is a write the nonces do not cover. Should the page text say so? No: the pages' comments teach the pattern correctly, the redundancy belongs to the retained key-remount idiom the acceptance note already names as a separate decision, and an example page should not teach a transient double read. The seat's 速读 sentence inherits the over-generalisation — see ③.

**(f) The test harness, outside the claim's file surface.** `examples/app-showcase/test/react-page-adapter-query-contract.test.ts` lifts the first `React.useEffect(…)` out of the renewals source verbatim and evaluates it through `new Function('React', 'adapter', 'sel', 'reload', …, 'setRelated', effectSource)`; the dependency array is an expression that call must evaluate, so the two identifiers this card adds threw `ReferenceError` four times at `2ecc5d7ff`. The four bounded-in-place conditions, judged at the head: ① same defect class — the harness enumerates exactly the dependency list the card edits, and it broke only because of this card's own edit; ② mechanical — two parameters and two `0` arguments in the shape the existing signature pins, plus a three-line comment; ③ no one else's claim — the file's last touches on `origin/main` are `eb10fcfd4` (2026-08-24) and `6cca75c3a` (2026-08-21), and `No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path` is success on the head; ④ same gate family — it runs under the showcase `vitest run` already in the verification set. All four hold. The edit does not weaken the test: the stub `React.useEffect` runs the body once and ignores the dependency array; the nonces are bound to `0` and never enter the body; the extraction control still asserts both `adapter.find` calls are in the lifted text, and the four executed-contract assertions (`$top` reaches the adapter, rows under `data`, `total` under a cap, `capped`) measure the body's run exactly as before. Nothing about re-runs was asserted before and nothing is now.

**(g) Scope.** Seven files; under `packages/spec` only `scripts/build-react-blocks-contract.ts`; nothing under `packages/lint`; no objectui file. The ⛔ lines of the claim hold.

**(h) The PR body.** At creation (13228 bytes): line 1 `Fixes #20395`; `Clause-②: no` at a line start; `## The hook, read at the pinned sha`; the `## skills/** readings` table with the two touched files (lines and tokens, the ratcheted one with its ceiling) and the whole-package / catalog rows; the generator diff summary (item 3 of `## What changed`); the session-URL footer once; no model identifier. `## 维护者速读(草稿)` absent at that read — the dev's deviation is accurate. At my second read (updated 03:34:10Z, 15213 bytes) the seat had appended that section (five parts and a one-line provenance note); line 1, the `Clause-②` line and the single footer are intact.

### ② Semver level

Nothing published changes. `@objectstack/spec` `files[]` is `dist, json-schema, liveness, prompts, llms.txt, README.md, src/**/*.zod.ts, CHANGELOG.md, api-surface, spec-changes.json` — `scripts/` is outside it. `@objectstack/example-showcase` is `private: true`. Of the 80 `package.json` files under `packages/` and `examples/` at the head, none has a `files[]` entry naming `skills` or `content`. No Zod schema, no protocol key, no export moves; the scope widening was objectui's half (`Clause-②: yes` there, PR objectui#10973). `Clause-②: no` is right, as the card body states. `skip-changeset` is correct; the seat applied it at about 03:34Z, and `Check Changeset` re-ran in the original check suite to success (03:34:36Z), superseding the 03:26:56Z failure that predated the label.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Missing 速读 draft** — declared by the dev (5924107460, the stored text); the seat has since appended it to the PR body (verified in the stored body). One correction for the seat's finalisation: its sentence「页面内自己保存后 effect 会跑两次(key 自增 + 总线事件),多一次读、结果不变」holds for `crm-workbench` only; on `renewals-pipeline` the page's own form writes `showcase_account`, which neither nonce reads, so the rollup runs once (①(e)). Prose, not diff; no code change needed.
- **File surface +1** — the test harness; the four conditions hold at the head (①(f)). The claim comment 5923384068 still lists six files at my read; the append of the seventh is the seat's pending write, as the dev asked.
- **Trailers** — the two published commits `2ecc5d7ff` and `c1770a387` both end with `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01KTZmMfzVzjNvyaLyQ8mHvg` and `Co-authored-by: Claude` at the anthropic address — the model-free pair. The refused first attempt never left the worktree (the pre-push hook runs `check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --pre-push`); nothing model-named is on the remote. Accepted.
- **`api_writes: 3`, one over the budget of 2** — the third was a `comment_edit` of the dev's own report to add the 速读 deviation the first copy omitted. The right call: the report comment is the dev's identity record and its GitHub copy must equal the terminal report; a second comment would have left two reports (the stale one un-marked) at the same write cost, and editing one's own comment is not the "state you did not set" class. Recorded with its reason; accepted, not escalated.
- **`mcp_calls: 0`** — consistent with the record: every comment on the card and the PR is authored by `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, and the dev names the `with-fleet.sh --via dispatch` relay for all three writes.
- **Gate claims against the head's check-runs.** The dev reports 94 derived families all exit 0 locally, plus `check:generated`, `check:skill-docs`, the token ratchet and its self-test, `check:react-blocks`, and `check-governed-merges --branch` = GOVERNED tier H via `skills/**` ×2 (48 changed lines). CI is the verdict. First read (runs completed up to 03:33:22Z): 32 runs — 21 success, 8 in_progress, 2 skipped, 1 failure (`Check Changeset`, pre-label). Second read, 03:38:33Z: 44 runs — 28 success, 9 skipped, 7 in_progress, 0 failure. Not success or skipped at the second read, all `in_progress`: `Lint & Repo Gates` (required); `Test Core (1/6)`, `(3/6)`, `(4/6)`, `(5/6)`, `(6/6)` (shards; `(2/6)` success; the required `Test Core` rollup not yet present); `Type Check · workspace` (`· source gates`, `· consumer gates`, `· debt ledger` success; the required `TypeScript Type Check` rollup not yet present). Skipped: `Console Pin Gate` (no `.objectui-sha` move), `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)` ×2, and in the two label-event suites `Auto Label`, `Check PR Size` and `Check Changeset` once each. Required contexts concluded success: `Build Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` (rollup and three shards), `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`. An in-progress required job is not a pass: three of the seven required contexts had not concluded at my read.
- **Landing.** The diff hits `skills/**` twice, so the PR is Tier H whole: this record is the contract review of record for the head and does not by itself lift the landing — that waits for an authorized APPROVED review by an account in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` and for the three open required contexts to conclude success, after which the owning seat lands it. No seat readies, queues or arms auto-merge before both.
- **Observed, not a defect.** The PR body's "What a page action now does" bullet over-generalises the double run and the key-remount rationale to both pages (①(e)); the dev's three acceptance notes (the redundant key-remount on the ListView block in `pages.md`'s Master/detail example and `crm-workbench`; the `os build` sentence in `pages.md`; the double read) are correctly left unfiled as boundary notes.

## 维护者速读

**改了什么**:objectui 那一半(PR objectui#10973,已在本仓钉住的控制台 `db11afd49` 内)把 `useDataInvalidation` 注入了 react 页面的作者作用域;本 PR 是 objectstack 这一半——react-pages 文档的作用域表与 Live data 示例、`objectstack-ui` 技能的一条规则、生成器 `build-react-blocks-contract.ts` 的两处字符串及其产物 `react-blocks.md`(经脚本重生成),以及 showcase 两个 react 页面在 `useAdapter` 读数据的 effect 依赖里加入 nonce。附带一处测试 harness 的机械修正(它枚举的正是本卡改的依赖列表)。

**为什么改**:裁决 A(objectui#10887 member 3,批次 #233 第 2 项,你 9 月 28 日「同意」)。PageView 页面动作后的整页 remount 已移除,读数据的块都走失效总线;react 页面自己的 `useAdapter` 读取若不接总线,就是唯一会留陈旧数据的面;技能与文档不教 nonce,AI 照抄出来的页面默认就是陈旧的。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改文档、技能、示例与一个示例测试,不碰协议键、不发包(`skip-changeset`);技能棘轮 `pages.md` 5681 → 5676 tokens(上限不动,新规则靠删同文件里重复的一句付账)。运行时影响仅限 showcase 两页:`crm-workbench` 在页内自己保存后 effect 会跑两次(key 自增 + 总线事件),多一次读、结果不变;`renewals-pipeline` 自己的表单写的是 `showcase_account`,两个 nonce 都不读它,只跑一次。复审(契约复审档,记录 5924298890)逐句在钉住的 sha 上核过。回滚 = revert。

**席位意见**:建议批准。三条观察留给后续(技能示例里对 ListView 的 key-remount 已属冗余;`os build` 那句只对 build 成立;上述双读),均不是本 PR 的缺陷。

**你要做的**:在本 PR 上留一条 APPROVED review(os-zhuang 或 hotlong)。本席本班收班,落地(清 `needs-user-decision`、翻 ready、挂 auto-merge)由下一任 skills 席按座位贴 #7623 的留守项执行;CI 尚有三项必查在跑,落地前需全绿。
